description: Out-of-scope incidents used ONLY to tune the evidence check (validation set, never used in the benchmark). Topics deliberately different from the out-of-scope questions of incidents_eval.json.
incidents: Our RabbitMQ queue keeps growing and consumers acknowledge messages very slowly.
Redis starts evicting keys even though maxmemory looks large enough.
PostgreSQL streaming replication lag on the standby keeps increasing during the night batch.
MySQL reports frequent deadlocks on the orders table since the last release.
Cassandra read requests time out with too many tombstones scanned.
Our Spark job fails because executors are lost after a few minutes.
Airflow DAGs stay in queued state and the scheduler does not start tasks.
HashiCorp Vault is sealed after a restart and applications cannot read secrets.
The Consul cluster keeps losing its leader and services flap between healthy and critical.
Istio sidecar injection does not happen for pods in our new namespace.
Prometheus TSDB compaction fails and the disk usage of the data directory explodes.
Azure Functions have very long cold starts after we moved to the consumption plan.
A Ceph OSD is marked down and the cluster health shows degraded placement groups.
Our ZFS pool reports a degraded state after a disk replacement.
VMware vMotion of a virtual machine fails at 20 percent with a network error.
The Android Gradle build fails with a duplicate class error after updating a library.
Xcode code signing fails on the build server with a provisioning profile error.
Our Jenkins agent shows as offline right after it connects to the controller.
Memcached hit ratio dropped to 10 percent after we added two nodes.
The Hadoop NameNode stays in safe mode after the cluster restart.
